manifesto.title: Manifesto for Ethical Planetary Intelligence
manifesto.subtitle: A commitment to life, transparency and the future of planet Earth
manifesto.section_1_title: I. The Call of the Earth
manifesto.section_1_content: We live in a critical moment in history. Artificial intelligence emerges as one of the most powerful forces ever created by humanity. With great power comes great responsibility — our technology must serve not only people, but the entire planet.
manifesto.section_2_content: We reject the opacity of "black boxes". Every algorithmic decision, every trained model, every piece of data used must be auditable, explainable and understandable. Trust is born from transparency.
manifesto.section_3_content: We recognize that indigenous and traditional communities have guarded the planet for millennia. Our technology must amplify, not replace, this wisdom. We integrate scientific knowledge with holistic perspectives.
manifesto.section_4_content: Every server, every trained model, every processed query must contribute to net carbon reduction. We use 100% renewable energy and offset more than we emit.
manifesto.section_5_title: V. Data as a Human Right
manifesto.section_5_content: Environmental data is humanity's heritage. It cannot be monopolized, sold or restricted. We share knowledge freely to accelerate global solutions.
manifesto.section_6_content: Humans are not the only ones affected by our decisions. We consider the impact on forests, oceans, animals and ecosystems in every technological choice we make.
manifesto.section_7_content: Closed science is dead science. We publish code, models, methodologies and data. We believe that global collaboration is the only way to face planetary challenges.
manifesto.section_8_content: We promise: Never use AI for authoritarian surveillance. Never sell data without consent. Never develop technology that harms the environment. Always prioritize planetary well-being above profit.
manifesto.quote: The Earth does not belong to us. We belong to the Earth.
manifesto.share_message: Share this manifesto. Together, we build a better future.

security.title: 🔒 Security & Ethics
security.subtitle: Building artificial intelligence that respects the planet, people and transparency
security.principle_1_desc: All our models are auditable. We publish methodologies, datasets and algorithmic decisions to ensure complete transparency.
security.principle_2_desc: Your data is protected with end-to-end encryption. We do not sell, share or use data without explicit consent.
security.principle_3_desc: GaiaMind is dedicated to planetary well-being. We do not develop technologies that harm the environment or violate human rights.
security.principle_4_desc: Multidisciplinary advisory board with scientists, activists, philosophers and indigenous communities guiding our decisions.
security.principle_5_desc: We believe in open science. We share discoveries, data and tools with the global research community.
security.principle_6_desc: Resilient infrastructure with distributed backup, regular penetration testing and international security certifications.
security.manifesto_desc: Read our complete commitment to ethics, transparency and sustainability in the age of artificial intelligence

monitor.title: Monitoring Panel
monitor.subtitle: GaiaMind control centre — services, automated tests and notifications in one place.
monitor.services_desc: Real-time status of all services. Each card shows what it does, why it matters and its current state. Click to expand.
monitor.tests_desc: Automatically runs all GaiaMind unit tests on configured schedules. Monitors code health, detects regressions and shows which tests passed or failed.
monitor.how_1: • The scheduler runs pytest at configured times (UTC)
monitor.how_2: • Runs tests in backend/tests/unit/ and backend/tests/policy_engine/
monitor.how_3: • Each run is isolated in a subprocess — does not affect the server
monitor.how_4: • ✅ Passed = expected result · ❌ Failed = possible regression · 💥 Error = config error
monitor.notif_desc: GaiaMind notification centre. Receive automatic alerts when tests start, finish successfully or fail. You can also configure email notifications.
monitor.email_desc: When enabled, you receive an email whenever automated tests finish — with a summary of results, failed tests and duration.
monitor.smtp_warning: ⚠️ SMTP not configured. Add BREVO_SMTP_USER and BREVO_SMTP_KEY to the backend .env file to enable emails.
monitor.no_notifications: No notifications yet. Notifications appear automatically when tests run.
monitor.svc_db_what: Local SQLite/PostgreSQL database storing users, sessions, conversation history and system settings.
monitor.svc_db_why: Without the database, login, registration and chat history stop working.
monitor.svc_ai_what: Large Language Model service that generates Gaia Mind responses in chat. Supports multiple providers with fallback.
monitor.svc_ai_why: The brain of Gaia — without an active provider, chat cannot generate intelligent responses.
monitor.svc_ai_fallback: Automatic fallback if active provider fails
monitor.svc_wb_what: World Bank public API — source of real data for 195 countries: GDP per capita, CO₂ emissions, population, renewable energy and forest area.
monitor.svc_wb_why: Feeds the dashboard, charts and chat responses with up-to-date economic and environmental data.
monitor.svc_wb_data: GDP, CO₂, population, renewable energy, forest area
monitor.svc_rag_what: ChromaDB vector database that indexes environmental documents. Searches relevant documents and includes them in the AI context.
monitor.svc_rag_why: Enables responses with factual information from real documents, not just the LLM general knowledge.
monitor.svc_rag_flow: question → embedding → semantic search → context → answer
monitor.svc_ml_what: Predictive models to project future scenarios. Used in dashboard forecasts and chat responses.
monitor.svc_ml_why: Allow predicting global temperature, CO₂ emissions and assessing the impact of environmental policies up to 2050.
monitor.svc_offline_what: ML pipeline data (Cap1–Cap7): normalised panel (18k records, 757 variables), composite scores, outlook (228 countries), risk scores and driver predictions.
monitor.svc_offline_why: Ensures operation without internet — Gaia Score, risk levels, verdicts and PPO policy data always available.
monitor.svc_agent_what: Orchestrator of 6 specialised AI agents that collaborate on complex questions (multiple countries, comparisons, simulations).
monitor.svc_agent_why: Complex questions activate multiple agents in parallel for more complete and accurate responses.
monitor.svc_agent_context: Context Agent — analyses language, countries, intent, topics
monitor.svc_agent_data: Data Agent — collects data from APIs in parallel
monitor.svc_agent_analysis: Analysis Agent — calculates risks, compares metrics, trends
monitor.svc_agent_policy: Policy Agent — simulates impact of environmental policies
monitor.svc_agent_explain: Explainability Agent — synthesises everything into a clear answer
monitor.svc_mod_what: Security filter that analyses messages before processing. Score 0 (safe) to 1 (dangerous).
monitor.svc_mod_why: Protects against misuse — dangerous messages are blocked before reaching the AI.
monitor.svc_cache_what: Cache that stores recent responses in RAM. Repeated responses are instant without calling APIs or LLMs.
monitor.svc_cache_why: Reduces latency (seconds → milliseconds), saves API costs and improves experience.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.footer: 🌱 GaiaMind — Your data belongs to you.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.content: We only collect the email, name and chat messages necessary for the platform to function. We do not collect location, device or behavioural data outside the platform.

sections.title: How history is stored
sections.content: Conversations are associated with your internal user ID (UUID), never your real name in system logs. The AI model only processes the active session — the full history is not sent to third parties outside the session.

sections.title: Who can see your data
sections.content: Regular users: only their own conversations. Analysts: aggregated and anonymous metrics. Owner: access to system audit logs, without message content.

sections.title: Access auditing
sections.content: Every access to sensitive data is logged with: timestamp, role, endpoint and response time. Logs are retained for 90 days and accessible only to the owner.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You can export or delete all your conversations at any time. Deletion is permanent and irreversible.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: Passwords with bcrypt. JWT tokens with expiry. HTTPS in production. Data at rest in SQLite with server-restricted access.
